summary: Profile of a surface checks a whole surface at once. The surface must fit between two boundaries that follow the true profile. With datums it also orients and locates the surface.

cell.zone: The whole surface must sit between two boundaries that follow the true profile. They sit equally either side of it unless the U symbol says otherwise.
cell.datum: Profile of a surface can be used with or without datums. Each datum it references adds orientation or location control.
cell.mmc: Profile never takes M or L on the tolerance. M or L may appear only on its datum references.
cell.applies: Use it on a surface of any shape, flat or curved, or on several surfaces together.
cell.also: It always controls form. With datums it also controls orientation and location. On its own, the zone also limits size where the surfaces form a size.
cell.confused: Shop practice: it is often mixed up with position. Profile is for surfaces. Position is for features of size.
cell.check: Shop practice: measure the surface with a CMM against the model, or compare a 3D scan.
